entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • XML document comment generation dots aren't dismissing on cursor move #83162
  • Code action fixer is seemingly hard coding windows line endings #83159
  • Use params collections and ORPA for APIs with both `params T[]` and `ImmutableArray<T>` overloads. #83155
  • Tooltip on char value using `\u01234` format should show the "display" value or info about the char #83154

Closed

  • Use params collections and ORPA for APIs with both `params T[]` and `ImmutableArray<T>` overloads. #83156
  • CA1859 (use concrete types) suggestion breaks compilation for interface #83152

Created

  • Unions: Align implementation with recent design changes around case types and default nullability #83161
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
